configuration.target_features_policy: explicit Config::target disables host-inferred feature flags

export const run = globalThis.applicationRun;
export function encode(value) { return JSON.stringify(value); }

limits: Unscored current-candidate diagnostic, exact full P/R matching scored packed-readonly artifacts. One host binary off/on/on/off.
Physical StoredValue allocations only; no source allocation origins, live heap, Node allocations or timing claim.
Field offsets and size are actual registered collector layout metadata; immutable tuples scanned only in new allocation ranges. Copied survivors excluded.
signed31_integer denotes the full mathematical range -2^30..2^30-1; it does not account for reserved singleton encoding collisions or all intermediate numeric computations.

prior_independent_controls.scope: Exact source-file and receipt pins only; five receipts cover 8 prior Wasmtime scanner/control tests. They precede ABI51 and are not candidate passes.

limits: Unscored diagnostic; all timings excluded. Counts are physical GC allocations including dead and host bridge allocations; copied survivors excluded.
The 13 labels identify physical Wasm GC types, not semantic source allocation sites.
Number category labels identify StoredValue payload classes; they do not cover transient Wasm numbers or all intermediate numeric computations.

prior_diagnostic.limits: The prior allocation/entry diagnostics retain their original runtime identity in the verified baseline archive. Current counts use the newly admitted P/R only.
